description: This script automates the process of generating documentation for plugins based on file changes within a codebase. It handles validation of JSON changes, determines which plugins need documentation updates, and invokes other scripts to generate markdown documentation from headers and JSON outputs. It also includes functions for post-processing markdown files and updating the documentation sidebar.

methods.name: get_plugin_from_path(file_path)
methods.description: Extracts the plugin name from a given file path based on the directory structure.

methods.name: validate_json_changes(changed_files)
methods.description: Checks if JSON files in 'apis/' have corresponding output files in 'tools/md_generator/json/'. Returns validation status and list of missing plugins.

methods.name: get_plugins_to_process(changed_files)
methods.description: Identifies which plugins need documentation regeneration based on changed files, categorizing these changes.

methods.name: generate_docs_for_plugin(plugin_name, file_types, logfile=None)
methods.description: Generates documentation for a specific plugin by invoking external scripts to process headers and JSON outputs.

methods.name: postprocess_md()
methods.description: Performs post-processing on generated markdown files to clean up and prepare for display.

methods.name: update_sidebar()
methods.description: Updates the documentation sidebar to reflect the latest generated content.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates validation, plugin processing, documentation generation, and post-processing.
